description: This file defines the UserProfileHandler class, which extends org.xml.sax.helpers.DefaultHandler to parse XML documents related to user profiles in the RomRaider project; it manages profile, parameter, switch, and external elements and provides a method to construct a UserProfile object from parsed data.

classes.name: UserProfileHandler
classes.description: Handles XML parsing for user profile data, maintaining internal maps of profile items and assembling a UserProfile object.

methods.name: startDocument
methods.description: Initializes maps for profile, switch, and external items at the start of XML document parsing.

methods.name: startElement
methods.description: Processes each XML element, extracting attributes and mapping them to internal data structures based on element type.

methods.name: getUserProfile
methods.description: Constructs and returns a UserProfile object from the parsed data.

methods.name: getUserProfileItem
methods.description: Creates a UserProfileItem object based on the element's attributes.
